brief: My wellness stack — 5 things that actually moved the needle.

slots.headline: What Changed the Game?
slots.subtitle: Five habits that moved the needle when nothing else stuck.

slots.title: The Wellness Stack
slots.body: I tried the trends. These five habits are the only ones that stuck — and actually changed how I feel, sleep, and think.

slots.title: Protect Deep Sleep
slots.body: Eight hours in bed is not negotiable. I wind down at 9, keep the room cold, and leave my phone in the hall. The return on energy is immediate.

slots.title: Move Every Morning
slots.body: Twenty minutes of walking or lifting before email. It anchors my mood and makes the day feel intentional instead of reactive.

slots.title: Eat Real Food First
slots.body: Protein and plants at every meal. I stopped counting calories and started counting energy crashes. My gut thanked me within a week.

slots.title: Morning Sunlight Ritual
slots.body: Ten minutes outside within an hour of waking. It resets my circadian rhythm better than any supplement or app ever did.

slots.title: One Digital Sabbath
slots.body: Sundays are offline. No scroll, no inbox. The mental white space is where my best ideas and actual rest finally show up.

slots.headline: What Is Your Stack?
slots.body: Drop one habit that moved the needle for you. I read every reply.
